notes.title: ( •̀ ω •́ ) what's this? MIKU? Demo out now? ˚.🎀༘⋆
notes.content:
A game that started as a sci-fi platformer about saving the universe (and my bank account) from ending, in an attempt to revive an old game jam project, by scavenging free assets off the internet. 

Eventually turned into a diary of the very thing I was trying to forget. 
About someone who got the best and worst out of me. A game about the bittersweet memories of love.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322102/32eb49e1adceb49038c368a6d75f01f230f9e859.jpg[/img]

Therapy? Too expensive. Making a game with free assets? A financially responsible way to suffer.

With the full release dropping soon, here’s a demo so y’all can get a taste of what’s coming.

I wish a happy suffering to everyone in the Demo, try it, regret it and come back to rage on it.

Wanna flex your speedrun? Gimme some feedback? Or just let people roast your gameplay? 

Join the [url=https://discord.gg/TgJkVAm2tp]discord server for MIKU[/url]

Now, run away before I force you to wishlist the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3495010

- revo
